papers.title: Synergistic effect of hydroxyapatite-titania nanocomposites derived from machining waste on the corrosion resistance of Ti6Al4V implants
papers.abstract: Abstract In this study, hydroxyapatite (HA) was synthesized via the sol–gel method and characterized to ensure phase purity and nanoparticle formation. Titanium machining chips were recycled and transformed into nanopowder using planetary ball milling to enhance material sustainability. Composite coatings of HA–TiO 2 were subsequently deposited onto Ti6Al4V alloy substrates through electrophoretic deposition (EPD) at a constant voltage of 45 V for 90 s, with HA contents of 10, 20, 30, and 40 wt%. After drying at ambient conditions, the coated samples were vacuum-sintered at 1100 °C for 4 h. Microstructural and phase analyses conducted by SEM and XRD revealed the formation of dense, homogeneous coatings composed of Ti, HA, and oxide phases. Based on EIS and polarization analyses in simulated body fluid, the corrosion resistance of all coated samples was considerably superior to that of the untreated Ti6Al4V alloy. Among them, the coating containing 30 wt% HA demonstrated the highest corrosion resistance, which was attributed to its uniform and stable phase distribution. Overall, this study presents a cost-effective and sustainable strategy to recycle Ti6Al4V machining chips for developing biocompatible coatings with superior corrosion protection for metallic implant applications.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti6Al4V合金的涂层处理，但未关注增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳或力学性能，且未涉及后处理对机械性能的影响。
llm.why_not_core: Not about additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; focus on corrosion resistance of coated wrought Ti6Al4V, not mechanical performance or fatigue; no post-processing for fatigue enhancement.

summary_zh.motivation: 回收钛加工废料制备生物相容涂层，提高Ti6Al4V植入物的耐腐蚀性。
summary_zh.method: 溶胶-凝胶合成羟基磷灰石，球磨回收钛屑，电泳沉积HA-TiO2复合涂层，真空烧结。
summary_zh.result: 含30wt% HA的涂层在模拟体液中耐腐蚀性能最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、XRD、EIS和极化曲线进行微观结构和电化学表征。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a sustainable and cost-effective biocompatible coating for Ti6Al4V implants by recycling titanium machining waste.
summary_en.method: Hydroxyapatite was synthesized via sol-gel, titanium chips were ball-milled into nanopowder, and HA-TiO2 composite coatings were deposited by electrophoretic deposition at 45 V for 90 s, followed by vacuum sintering at 1100 °C.
summary_en.result: The coating with 30 wt% HA exhibited the highest corrosion resistance in simulated body fluid due to uniform phase distribution.
summary_en.validation: Microstructure and corrosion performance were validated using SEM, XRD, EIS, and polarization testing in simulated body fluid.

papers.title: Thermal dynamics in direct laser metal deposition of Ti-6Al-4V: comparative study of linear and trochoidal path strategies
papers.abstract: Abstract Direct laser metal deposition is a versatile additive manufacturing technique known for its ability to fabricate complex geometries with high precision. However, the thermal history during deposition can significantly influence the microstructure, distortions, and mechanical properties of the final product. This study investigates the influence of scanning path strategies, namely linear bidirectional (conventional), flattened trochoidal (fully circular), and adaptive trochoidal (semi-circular), on the thermal dynamics and resulting material characteristics in direct laser metal deposition (DLMD) of Ti-6Al-4V alloy. Using infrared thermal imaging, detailed comparisons were made of the thermal history, cooling rates, and spatial heat distribution at different scan speeds (100, 250, and 400 mm/min). Results revealed that the adaptive trochoidal path produced the most thermally balanced behaviour, with up to 18% lower peak temperatures and 25–30% lower temperature fluctuation range compared to the linear bidirectional strategy. Cooling rate analysis showed that adaptive trochoidal scanning maintained a more gradual cooling slope, especially at the middle point. Microstructural examination confirmed a finer grain structure in trochoidal paths, particularly adaptive ones, correlating with a 10–15% increase in microhardness compared to linear scanning. The study highlights how path shape optimization can significantly improve thermal management and enhance mechanical performance in DLMD applications, providing valuable insights for the design of complex geometries in additive manufacturing.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了激光直接金属沉积Ti-6Al-4V的路径策略对热历史和显微硬度的影响，但与疲劳性能无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: Does not report tensile strength, yield strength, elongation, or fatigue life; only microhardness and microstructure.

summary_zh.motivation: 探明扫描路径策略对DLMD Ti-6Al-4V热动力学的调控作用
summary_zh.method: 利用红外热成像比较线性、全圆形和半圆形路径在不同扫描速度下的热历史与冷却速率
summary_zh.result: 自适应圆形路径使峰值温度降低18%，显微硬度提高10-15%
summary_zh.validation: 通过热成像、金相和显微硬度实验验证

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates how scanning path strategies influence thermal dynamics during DLMD of Ti-6Al-4V to improve mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: Infrared thermal imaging was used to compare linear bidirectional, flattened trochoidal, and adaptive trochoidal paths at various scan speeds.
summary_en.result: The adaptive trochoidal path reduced peak temperatures by 18% and increased microhardness by 10-15% compared to linear scanning.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via in-situ thermal imaging, microstructural analysis, and microhardness testing.
